decisions.reason: Concluding further design revisions does not change the previously selected champagne-gold finish or its material constraints.
The source ends further revision work but does not revoke the established rule that the É accent derives literally from the Hero V terminal.
The source reports failure to preserve the second-V geometry, which is already represented as a same-message runtime failure; it does not establish a new construction value.
The project conclusion does not alter the selected Balanced Flow kerning or the cohesive-reading goal.
Failure to preserve the locked hierarchy is already recorded as a same-message runtime failure; the source does not replace or cancel the hierarchy values.
The source does not state that the É-accent peak-alignment rule changed or was revoked.
The instruction to stop revisions does not change the previously selected distribution of champagne gold across the signature elements.
The source contains no decision changing the all-caps wordmark treatment.
The project conclusion does not alter the established shared-baseline alignment rule.
A complete same-message MODIFY already replaces the prior final-artwork standard with the required handoff of all current editable files, source vectors, boards, and exports.
The source requests existing files but does not specify or change the accepted formats for review-preview images.
